promptState.text: A selfie photograph of a 20-year-old Romanian woman on a small apartment balcony on a summer morning, taken with a phone's front camera at arm's length, held a little above her eye level. Her camera-right arm reaches toward the lens and leaves the frame at the bottom corner. Her camera-left hand makes a peace sign beside her cheek, palm toward the camera, index and middle fingers raised and the other fingers folded. She has an oval face, blue-grey eyes, full natural brows and faint freckles across her nose, her fair skin with fine pores, a light shine on the nose and a natural, uneven tone. Her honey-brown hair is pulled into a messy high ponytail, flyaway strands lifted by the breeze. She wears a white cotton t-shirt printed across the chest with the word "PIXA" in chunky rounded retro letters in pink. The frame runs from just above her ponytail to the middle of her chest, with the whole word inside it. She gives the lens a relaxed, closed-mouth smile. Behind her are the white metal balcony railing with terracotta pots of red geraniums, a folding clothes rack with a striped towel, and the orange tiled roofs and treetops of the town under a pale blue sky, all fairly sharp in the phone's wide lens. Clear morning sun from camera-left lights her face with a small catchlight in each eye, the camera-right side of her face in soft shade. An unedited phone photo: true-to-life colour, the slightly bright sky and crisp sharpening of a phone camera, a little noise in the shadows.

{"version":1,"content":"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 Google Gemini Free Prompting Gem

Type a short idea into the Gem and it writes the long, detailed prompt FLUX 3 works best with. Paste it into 1. your prompt.

Tip: start your message with write the prompt: so Gemini writes a prompt and does not try to make the picture itself. It is free with a Google account.

FLUX 3 Prompt Writer 

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 Load Diffusion Model (Z-Image Turbo, the realism pass)

Download z_image_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors6.20 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/z-image

Create the z-image folder if it does not exist.

 Load CLIP (Qwen 3 4B, for Z-Image)

Download qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors5.63 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE (Z-Image)

Download ae.safetensors335 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 Load Upscale Model

Download 4x_NMKD-Siax_200k.pth67 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/upscale_models

Already have Z-Image Turbo? Skip only the files with these exact names: the bf16 versions are different files.

 License

Z-Image Turbo is made by Alibaba's Tongyi Lab and released under the Apache 2.0 license.

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Two models, one Run. FLUX 3 Klein makes the picture from your prompt, then Z-Image Turbo repaints it lightly at twice the size. The picture, the pose and any words stay the same; skin, eyes, hair and fabric get sharper and more real. The colours stay close to the FLUX 3 picture.

 Steps

  1. Write your prompt in Prompt Pixaroma.
  2. Pick the size of the first picture on Sizes Pixaroma: the result is twice as big.
  3. Leave the seed on F to repeat a picture, or R for a new one every Run.
  4. Pick the denoise of the realism pass on Number Pick Pixaroma: 0.2 is the default.
  5. Press Run. Drag across Image Compare to see before and after.

 Denoise: how much the pass may repaint

A higher denoise is not more realism. It lets Z-Image repaint more of the picture, which adds texture but also brings problems. 0.2 gave the best result in our tests.

DenoiseWhat you get
0.15The lightest touch: sharper, almost the same picture
0.2The default: real skin, hair strands and fabric, the picture kept
0.25More skin texture and pores
0.3Strong texture; skin starts to look grainy and older

 Above 0.3 the picture starts to change and the skin turns grainy. At 0.45 in our tests, Z-Image even wrote the shirt's word on the woman's cheeks when the word was in its prompt. That is why its prompt is fixed and has no words in quotes.

 Good to know

  • The realism prompt (CLIP Text Encode, realism prompt) is the same for every picture. You do not need to change it.
  • FLUX 3 and Z-Image together are about 23 GB. On a 24 GB card ComfyUI swaps them in and out, which is fine. With less memory it is slower, but it still runs.
  • Hands and faces are as good as the FLUX 3 picture: the pass sharpens them, it does not fix a wrong hand. Try another seed for that.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 15 steps, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.
  • Load Diffusion Model (Z-Image Turbo, realism pass) - The second model, Z-Image Turbo (int8). It does not make a new picture: it repaints the FLUX 3 picture lightly at twice the size, which gives more real skin, hair and fabric.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3 4B, for Z-Image) - Z-Image's own text encoder. The type must be lumina2.
  • Load VAE (Z-Image) - Z-Image's VAE: turns the bigger picture into Z-Image's format and back.
  • Load Upscale Model (4x NMKD Siax) - Loads the upscale model, 4x NMKD Siax, made for photos: it makes the picture 4 times bigger before the realism pass.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Prompt Pixaroma (1. your prompt) - The prompt box. The demo prompt is a full description of a phone selfie: write yours the same way (see How to Use in workflow 1).
  • Sizes Pixaroma (2. picture size) - The size of the FIRST picture. The final picture is twice as big: the demo's 1024 x 1280 becomes 2048 x 2560.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. fixed or random) - The seed of the first picture. F (fixed) repeats it, R (random) makes a new one each Run. The demo uses seed 2.
  • Number Pick Pixaroma (4. realism pass denoise) - The denoise of the realism pass: how much of the picture Z-Image may repaint. 0.2 (the default) sharpens skin, hair and fabric and keeps the picture. A higher number is NOT more realism: it repaints more, so the skin turns grainy and older-looking and things can change, even words appearing where they should not.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (15 steps) - The render: 15 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple. Black Forest Labs' own workflow uses 16 steps. In our tests 8 steps gave nearly the same picture in about half the time; more than 16 steps made skin smoother and more waxy.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.
  • ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 3, for Z-Image) - A setting Z-Image Turbo needs (shift 3, from ComfyUI's own Z-Image workflow). Leave it as it is.
  • Upscale Image (using Model) (4x bigger) - Makes the FLUX 3 picture 4 times bigger with the upscale model.
  • Upscale Image By (0.5 = 2x the first size) - Brings it back to 2 times the first size (half of the 4x), so the realism pass works on a 2048 x 2560 picture.
  • VAE Encode (picture to Z-Image latent) - Turns the bigger picture into Z-Image's format, so the realism pass starts FROM it instead of from noise.
  • CLIP Text Encode (realism prompt, leave as it is) - A fixed prompt for the realism pass that works for any picture: it asks for sharp, real detail. It has NO words in quotes on purpose: a quoted word here can get painted anywhere in the picture, even on a face.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. Z-Image Turbo runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one.
  • KSampler (realism pass, 5 steps) - The realism pass: 5 steps, CFG 1, dpmpp_2m_sde, beta (ComfyUI's own Z-Image upscale workflow). Its denoise comes from Number Pick: how much of the picture it may repaint.
  • VAE Decode (the finished picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the final picture) - Saves the final, bigger picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Realism.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (before and after, drag across it) - The FLUX 3 picture and the realism pass on top of each other. Drag across it to compare; zoom in on a face to see the difference.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
FLUX 3, 1024 x 1280about 3 s
Realism pass to 2048 x 2560about 17 s
One Run, start to endabout 20 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and Z-Image Turbo with their text encoders, about 23 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.
